abstract: We report six case histories of malignant tumours following abortion of moles. In three cases their surgical removal allowed us to control them by histology: two of these were destruens chorio-adenomata, one case only was a choriocarcinoma. In the three other cases the cure was obtained by the sole use of anti-mitotic drugs. This treatment was undertaken on bioclinical evidence of malignancy which is certainly not foolproof, but which is practical in use, when one appreciates how difficult it is to diagnose some of these post-mole tumours histologically. There is a place for the surgical treatment of these cases in spite of the usefulness of Methotrexate. This place varies according to the age of the patients and the resistance of the tumours to treatment with anti-mitotic drugs.
abstract_ja: 奇胎娩出後に生じた悪性腫瘍の6症例を報告する。3例では外科的切除により組織学的検討が可能で、破壊性絨毛腺腫2例と絨毛癌1例であった。残る3例は抗有糸分裂薬のみで治癒した。この治療は悪性を示唆する臨床的所見に基づいて行われた。奇胎後腫瘍は組織学的診断が困難であり、確実ではないものの臨床的判断は実用的である。外科的治療は、患者の年齢や腫瘍の抗有糸分裂薬への抵抗性に応じて、メトトレキサートの有用性にもかかわらず、一定の役割を有する。
